question: Who among the following is the author of the novel ‘Maila Anchal’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Phanishwar Nath ‘Renu’ **__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• 'Maila Anchal' is a significant work in the Hindi literature.
 
• It is considered a pioneering piece in the realm of regional narrative.
 
• The novel brings to life the social fabric of the rural India of its time.
 
• Phanishwar Nath 'Renu' is renowned for his contribution to Hindi literature, especially in the realm of rural narratives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 'Maila Anchal' was published in the year 1954.
 
• It is often cited as the first Hindi novel to give a vivid description of the rural life in Bihar.
 
• The novel has been praised for its exploration of the complex social and economic issues facing the rural populace.
 
• Phanishwar Nath 'Renu' has been awarded several honors for his literary contributions, including 'Maila Anchal'.
 
• The work has had a profound influence on Hindi literature, inspiring a generation of writers to focus on regional stories.
